receiver: WS1 I2 seed browser, later I3 encounter and WS-Audio I6
scope: data-only planning · no scene, game, audio, figure, asset, Site or Stage mutation

method.weightScale: Integer weights, each peer distribution sums to 100; NOT measured probabilities or approved balance.
method.selection: Overlay these family weights as data onto existing kfb-place / WFC solve; do not create a second generator.
method.determinism: Stable seed and stable canonical deckId/cardNumber and cell ID must replay same output; local group random draws must not re-roll ancestors.
method.grouping: Three-rule proposal uses L/M/S roles; kfb.place/1 rules.group.sizes [1,0.62,0.38], sink/contact/gate and non-clone constraints remain authoritative.
method.visualTruth: Deck PDF crop is authoritative; text JSON supplies semantics, artworkPrompt is not image truth; no invented asset IDs or character-to-deck canon assignments.
method.colourTruth: Six existing world palettes and their role colours remain in kfb.color-concept/1; story mode is overlay, not replacement; painted Meshy only gentle tint.
method.outlierGate: Candidate only where playable routes, sightline, collision/contact, identity, readable cards, and the kfb-place adjacency rules remain valid.
method.residentGate: All residentCandidateIds are affinity suggestions only; do not auto-assign signatureDeck or overwrite kfb.character/1.1 fields with todo or non-GEORG status.
method.billboardGate: Resolve actual cover or [deckId,cardNumber] against registry and original PDF; avoid repeating same card art within a deck-quarter.
method.audioGate: Bed family strings are conceptual search labels, not verified loops, licenses or new mixer contracts; WS-Audio owns selection/mix.
method.themesGate: 130 deck assignments are an editorial first pass; 104 TBD bundleSuggestions are not evidence of accepted canonical categories.
